tasks.description: Implement pure versioned backup serialization and parsing in src/tasks.js. Export all tasks as UTF-8 JSON text with a top-level version number 1 and tasks array. Parse imported text, reject malformed JSON, unsupported version, invalid task schema, and duplicate IDs before returning a new task array. Reuse existing validateTask/parseTasks rules and preserve every valid task field. Do not read or write localStorage inside these helpers. Add deterministic model tests including empty and non-empty roundtrips and no mutation on failures.
acceptance_criteria: Export returns valid JSON with version 1 and every supplied task, including an empty array; it does not mutate the input.
Import returns a new validated task array and rejects malformed JSON, unsupported version, malformed tasks, and duplicate IDs with useful errors.
Invalid import never mutates input tasks or storage; existing STORAGE_KEY, loadTasks, and saveTasks behavior remains compatible.
Tests use fixed IDs and timestamps and cover roundtrip, empty board, duplicate IDs, unsupported version, malformed JSON, and invalid task schema.

tasks.description: Add an Export JSON control in index.html and wire src/app.js to call the pure backup serializer on the current task array. Download a UTF-8 application/json Blob with a timestamped filename via an object URL, then revoke the URL. Put a deterministic filename helper in src/tasks.js if needed for testability. Show failures through the existing status message. No network requests or external packages.
acceptance_criteria: Export control downloads all current tasks, including an empty board, as a versioned UTF-8 JSON file.
Filename includes a stable ISO-derived timestamp without filesystem-hostile colons; object URL is revoked after download.
Export does not change tasks or localStorage, and any user-provided text is rendered with textContent.
Deterministic tests cover the pure serializer and filename rule; npm test and both Node syntax checks pass.

tasks.description: Add an Import JSON file control in index.html and wire src/app.js to read its UTF-8 text, call the pure parser, and show the validated task count in a clear replacement confirmation. Only after confirmation, use existing saveTasks(localStorage, importedTasks), assign the task array, and call existing render(). Report errors in the existing status element. Cancel and every validation or save failure leave the current board and storage unchanged. Reset the file control so the same file can be selected again. Do not create a new storage key or use network requests.
acceptance_criteria: Import control validates version, task schema, and unique IDs before showing a confirmation with the number of tasks; malformed or unsupported files show an error.
Cancel and failed parse/validation/save do not change the current task array or the value at STORAGE_KEY.
Successful import replaces and persists through saveTasks, calls render(), and works for zero tasks as well as non-empty boards.
No external packages, network calls, or innerHTML for user data; npm test and node --check src/app.js and src/tasks.js pass.
